name: paseo-kit
description: A collection of Paseo plugins: host-monitor, ccusage-stats, file-download and tab-recovery.

scripts.install:all: for d in plugins/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm install) || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck: for d in plugins/*/; do echo "== $d"; (cd "$d" && npm run --silent typecheck) || exit 1; done
